But since Farrokh and Crystal have taken over,  we have been extremely satisfied with AC. They are responsive, take corrective measures, proactive, and professional.  But the bottomline is that they are a great service to use. We love the fact that the AC agents are bilingual. We love the fact that we can depend on them 24 x 7. Every time I've called in to test how professional they are, they AC agents have not let me down. But I can't express how much I appreciate what Crystal has done, but now Farrokh has been the very best in getting things done for us. We've had multiple emergencies that had to do with growth and Farrokh was not only thorough but his support has been stellar. You can't get better quality and service than this team. I would highly recommend them and will not want to use any other service. We have been growing exponentially, and AC is absolutely scalable. Highly recommend.  A solid five stars.
